videos.description: The Bowling Green Falcons visit the No. 23 Indiana Hoosiers in NCAA Division I Men's Basketball game. Bowling Green defeated Gardner-Webb 91-65 with Makhi Leach, while No. 23 Indiana ride a seven-game win streak with Darren Harris.

videos.title: Live: B1G Tailgate
videos.description: Start off game day with the Big Ten Network crew previewing this week's games from around the conference. Plus, Camryn Irwin and Tyvis Powell travel to campus for interviews and on-site analysis. B1G Tailgate is the home for Big Ten football fans on Saturdays with original features, special guests and college football analysis.

videos.title: Live: B1G Countdown to Kickoff
videos.description: Countdown to Kickoff takes you on the field leading up to game time with previews of the day's biggest games, plus the latest news from reporters across the country.

videos.title: Live: College Football
videos.description: The Wildcats (6-5, 3-5 Big Ten) host the Fighting Illini (6-5, 4-4) at Ryan Field in Evanston. Illinois seeks to snap a two-game skid after a 34-17 loss to Iowa, while Northwestern aims to end a four-game slide after falling 20-17 to Minnesota.

videos.title: B1G Live: Football Game Break
videos.description: Our analysts check in on the action all across the B1G as football Saturday continues.

videos.title: Live: College Football
videos.description: The Rutgers Scarlet Knights (3-8, 2-6 Big Ten) host the Michigan State Spartans (3-8, 1-7) at SHI Stadium in Piscataway. Michigan State seeks to snap a two-game skid after a 45-7 loss to Oregon, while Rutgers beat Penn State 25-24 in Week 12.

videos.title: B1G Live: Football Postgame
videos.description: Recap the games from around the conference along with postgame sound from coaches and players.

videos.title: Live: College Basketball
videos.description: The California Golden Bears (5-2) take on the undefeated Minnesota Golden Gophers (7-0) at Sanford Pentagon. California enters on a three-game win streak after routing Alabama State 96-54, while Minnesota seeks to make it eight straight victories.

videos.title: Live: College Basketball
videos.description: The Lipscomb Bisons (4-5) visit the Ohio State Buckeyes (4-3) at Schottenstein Center in Columbus. Lipscomb enters following a 101-66 loss to Auburn, while Ohio State saw its two-game win streak end after falling 72-66 to Vanderbilt.

videos.title: Live: College Basketball
videos.description: The Norfolk State Spartans (2-6) battle the Washington Huskies (5-2) at Alaska Airlines Arena. Norfolk State seeks to snap a six-game skid following an 80-49 loss to NC State, while Washington has alternated wins and losses over its last four games.
